summary: Date field: a native date input plus a button that opens a calendar popup. Use for one calendar date; the value is an ISO date string.

usage.text: value is an ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD, or empty, and the form receives it under name. min and max use the same format; a date outside them is invalid with a built-in message.
input and change carry detail.value. Picking a day fires both, closes the calendar and returns focus to the input. The native input's own input event also reaches host listeners, without detail.
Open the calendar with show(), toggleOpen() or the open attribute; close it with hide(). open-change fires with detail.open on each change, and once with false when the element connects.
locale (a BCP 47 tag; default the page lang) sets the calendar's month and weekday names only. The native input shows the date in the browser's own format.

a11y.text: ArrowDown in the input opens the calendar and focuses a day. Escape closes it and returns focus to the input, and is stopped so an enclosing dialog stays open. An outside click also closes it.
The calendar button is named "Choose date", or "Change date" once a value is set, and exposes aria-expanded. The popup panel itself has no dialog role.

roles.name: from the displayed month and year
